cause_quote: The commit deleted the cache writer together with `sweepMaterializedArchiveCache(cacheDir)` and its 24-hour `MATERIALIZED_ARCHIVE_CACHE_TTL_MS` age sweep, so existing session-archive-read-cache files no longer had any code path that removed them.
user_saw: After upgrading, plaintext session archive cache files from older versions stayed in the OpenClaw temp directory indefinitely, keeping disk space (the exhaustion reported in #193193) and plaintext transcript copies around.
summary: Adds a Doctor check that reports leftover session-archive-read-cache bytes read-only and, on repair (including the update path), removes recognized legacy cache files and the empty directory.
reasoning: Before #193548 the materializer swept cache entries older than 24 hours on each archive read; bfbb6560585b (#193548, landed an hour earlier) removed both the writer and that sweep without a migration, leaving existing files permanently orphaned. I read the removed sweep in that diff; the fix is the missing cleanup for that cutover. Confidence is medium because one could also view this as a one-time cleanup (not-a-defect), but the pre-existing behavior of reclaiming old entries was removed by a specific commit.
